$comment: Contract for one classification record produced by the LLM classifier (work/llm/*.json) and by the review patch (work/review_patch.json). tools/merge.py validates against this. Module/submodule/area must be ids from tools/taxonomy.json.

key.description: SYSTEM|TYPE|NAME exactly as given in the batch file

module.description: top-level taxonomy id, e.g. HCM, MM, FI, BC, UNKNOWN

submodule.description: child of module, e.g. HCM-PT; null if undecidable

area.description: child of submodule, e.g. HCM-PT-TS; null if undecidable

purpose.description: one line, business language: what this object does

rationale.description: the evidence that decided it (tables, FMs, BAdIs, callers)

flags.description: optional: cross-module, utility, obsolete-candidate, test-code, mixed-fugr, needs-human, mislabeled-package, interface, report-only, generated, copy-of-standard, dead-code

secondary.description: optional further assignments when the object materially serves another module. The primary assignment is role 'direct'.

process.description: optional explicit business-process assignments (ids from tools/taxonomy/processes.json). When empty, merge derives them from the module via tools/taxonomy/crosswalk.json (basis 'crosswalk').

review_state.description: set by the review stage only; classifier output is always 'proposed'

prompt_version.description: optional; merge fills the file-level prompt_version or the built-in constant

derived_per_object.$comment: Added by merge.py to every object in work/classification.json

batch_result_file.$comment: Shape of work/llm/NNN.json written by the classifier agent
